sentences.text: Coram: Vinay Joshi And Mrs.Vrushali V. Joshi, Jj.

2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report bearing Crime No.63 of 2023
registered with the Ranapratap Nagar Police Station, Nagpur City for the offence punishable under
Sections 406, 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 of the Maharashtra
Protection of Interest of Depositors (In Financial Establishments) Act, 1999.
3.
It is the informant's case that under the Scheme run by the applicant and her husband, he has deposited 41.20 lakhs on a promise of higher returns.
Since the promise turns to be failed, the informant realized that he has been deceived, hence the report.
4. It is the applicant's contention that there is considerable delay of three years in lodgment of report.
Particularly it is submitted that the entire informant's transaction was with the deceased husband of the applicant, hence she has no concerned.
